name: smwmusic-little-red-hood-nes-unlicensed-main-theme
title: Little Red Hood (NES Unlicensed) - Main Theme
description:
Merry Christmas!.. I guess...

This rather peculiar track plays in the Unlicensed NES game, Little Red Hood.

As far as I know (+ Zophar telling me) this is the only song that plays in the game, yup, nothing else, just this the whole game.
The game itself is known to be very cryptic and sometimes downright unplayable, almost everything is basically random.

I wont go into too much detail, but if you are interested, check it out somewhere on the internet. (AVGN made a video on it as well)

That's it, I guess, happy holidays!
